fusions.name: Closing Grip
fusions.desc: A grasping strike that deals 18 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Clenched Reef
fusions.desc: Closes a fist of growing reef on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving each [Caged] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Passed Down the Line
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Grown Glove
fusions.desc: Conjures a glove of living reef: your critical chance rises by 3%, your critical hits deal 0.1x more, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and each kill returns 4 health.
